verdict.rationale: Honcho documents named-scope API keys that bind a key to one named scope for recall and message ingestion, a basic first-party control over who can read and write memory. Workspaces provide isolation between applications or environments. Missing for 10: roles or RBAC, policy or ACL definitions, per-entity read/write permissions, any access audit logging, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can govern who and what can read or write memory with roles, policies, or access-control lists, and audit that access

citations.quote: Named-scope API keys: a key bound to one named scope, for recall and for message ingestion (including creating new member sessions).
Workspaces - Top-level containers that isolate different applications or environments
